frames.title: A Quiet Bloom
frames.comment: A delicate pink rose surrounded by deep green foliage.

frames.title: The Freedom of Being Little
frames.comment: Anna and her daughter Hazel playing in the backyard. These are the kinds of everyday moments I love documenting on film.

frames.title: Karli at Otter Point in Acadia National Park
frames.comment: Karli was barefoot on the rocks at Otter Point when she looked back at me. The sun was low enough to catch the side of her dress and bring out the warm color in the rocks. I kept the frame wide so I could get the blue water and all that sky in the same shot.
